plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-027 RFQ absent in saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Set the configuration whose effect on the draft's offered RFQ stage is being tested.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the test case before creating the draft.
Apply a template so the draft can be populated and saved.
Add the required line item for a valid saved draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving.
Create the saved eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the scenario.
Confirm the newly saved draft is present before opening it.
Open the test's saved draft from the Drafts list.
Open the draft's Add Stages menu where the RFQ offering is exposed.
Assert that RFQ is not offered in the saved draft.
